chunks: As for whatever is in it from Hāshim al-Ḥannāṭ, I have transmitted it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim; and Aḥmad ibn Isḥāq ibn Saʿd, from Hāshim al-Ḥannāṭ.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: Al-Saffar, a key intermediary in the transmission chain
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating the author’s mode of narration
key_terms.عَنْ: From; the transmission term marking links in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.هَاشِمِ الْحَنَّاطِ: Hashim al-Hannat, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Hāshim al-Ḥannāṭ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Hāshim al-Ḥannāṭ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It serves as a chain-identification notice, linking the author to Hāshim al-Ḥannāṭ through named intermediaries and contributing to hadith documentation and source transparency.
